summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of Skill Flow completed successfully. 21/21 backend API tests pass (auth Bearer, dashboard, skill-gap, learning-path with toggle persist, projects with status persist, opportunities, applications CRUD, careers, progress, profile, proof-of-skills). Real Claude AI streaming via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY verified from both curl and the real UI (arithmetic probe '17+26' correctly returned 43 - no silent fallback). All UI pages load with expected content, sidebar navigation works, session persists on refresh via localStorage 'sf_token', logout works, landing page renders CTA correctly.
ai_feature_verdicts: AI Chat (Claude claude-sonnet-4-6, streaming) - pass - primary AI feature. Evidence: POST /api/ai/chat streamed reply text '43' for probe 'What is 17 + 26? Reply with just the number.' (backend pytest + real UI). Second probe returned personalized career mentor text referencing student data. No 'having trouble' fallback. skill: ai-testing-llm
critical_code_review_comments: server.py sets httpOnly cookies in addition to returning the Bearer token even though the task brief says cookies are intentionally not used. This is redundant but not broken; frontend correctly relies on Bearer only.

Demo user's readiness shows 7% on dashboard (skills coverage vs software-developer catalog is low). Not a bug per test brief but business logic may want tuning - readiness feels punishingly low despite 7 seeded skills.
server.py fallback in /api/ai/chat swallows all exceptions; consider logging provider status distinctly from generic errors so silent fallbacks are detectable in prod.
Applications 'stats.responseRate' arithmetic uses status only, not appliedDate normalization - minor.

Pytest run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_skillflow_backend.py -v. AI feature uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY with anthropic claude-sonnet-4-6 via emergentintegrations library; streaming works.
